To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the dual PI3k/mTOR inhibitor, SAR245409 (XL765), is superior to the PI3k or mTOR inhibitors in prostate cancer cell lines and that this effect is associated to CRM1-mediated nuclear localization of Foxo-1.
the dual PI3 kinase/mTOR inhibitor (SAR245410) is superior to the single PI3 kinase (SAR245407) or mTOR inhibitors (rapamycin), in prostate cancer cell lines.

the use of a dual PI3K/MTOR inhibitor is more effective than the use of a single PI3K or MTOR inhibitor to induce prostate cancer cell death, and the efficacy of the dual PIK3/MTOR inhibitor in inducing prostate cancer cell death is greater in hormone-insensitive models than in hormone-sensitive models.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new therapeutic strategies in prostate cancer treatment.
the identification of the most effective PI3K/AKT/mTOR inhibitors in prostate cancer models and the identification of biomarkers that can be used to predict the most effective treatment.
the use of a dual PI3K/ mTOR inhibitor, XL-765, in prostate cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the XL765 effects were superior than those observed with the XL147 or rapalogs in prostate cancer cell lines and derivatives.
the use of dual PI3K/ mTOR inhibitors is more efficient than the sole PI3KI or mTOR inhibition in prostate cancer models.
the dual PI3k/mTOR inhibitor (SAR245410) shows a superior effect to the PI3k inhibitor (XL147, SAR245408) and the mTOR inhibitor (rapamycin).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the dual PI3 kinase/mammalian target of the rapamycin (PI3K/mTOR) inhibitor, XL765, is a more effective agent than the PI3K inhibitor, XL147, or the mTOR inhibitor, rapamycin, in prostate cancer cells.
the use of a dual PI3K and Akt inhibitor, such as XL765, would be more effective than a single PI3K or Akt inhibitor, such with XL147 or rapalogs.
the dual PI3k/Akt/mTOR inhibitor (SAR245410) showed superior effects in prostate cancer cell lines when compared to the sole PI3k or mTOR inhibitor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
dual PI3K and Akt inhibition is more effective than the sole inhibition of these kinases or the mTOR inhibition in prostate cancer cells.

the dual PI3 kinase (PI3K)-mammalian target rapamycin (MTOR) inhibitor XL765 has superior effects to sole inhibitors of PI3K (e.g., XL147) and mTOR (e.g., rapamycin) in prostate cancer cell lines and derivatives, and that this effect may be related to the CRM1-mediated nuclear localization of GSK3β and Foxo-3.
